metadata.description: Build the Linux Terminal's git store guard (store-guard/, Rust, static musl) and stage it with its NOTICE and manifest under out/store-guard/linux-x64 (Linux git parity blueprint, LP2 and LP8). Linux x64 only; rustup installs the pinned toolchain on first run.

The store guard's Rust unit tests, clippy (warnings denied) and rustfmt. The mounted acceptance cases (store-guard/tests/acceptance.sh) need FUSE and bubblewrap and run in the Linux shell-conformance guest.

The native shell conformance rows (T02, E rows a provider owns): the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, network negatives judged by canaries outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Cacheable only under the shell environment fingerprint (scripts/src/shell-evidence.ts, CF-1): the hash covers the source closure and the row's OS, kernel, Bash, runner image, sandbox runtime and node-pty, and is a fresh nonce unless the run asked for reuse, so candidate, drift and promotion runs never hit. A hit restores the receipt that first proved the verdict and its verdict record; the workflow's uncached stamp step says so.
